exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: брать — to take; собра́ние — meeting, gathering; забо́р — fence; собра́ть — to gather, to collect.
**разобрал** — разобра́ть (perfective): to dismantle, to disassemble, to take apart, to deconstruct; to analyse, to parse; to take, buy up, snap up; to make out, read. Wiktionary: разо- + брать.
